snippet.title: Jikoronpa: Laments of Isolation Opening (Danganronpa Fangame)
snippet.description:
Lyrics by Laments
Song + Mastering by Dewdroppe

_______

Lyrics:

Be your own person
In a world of greed
Be your own person
In a world not need
-ing you

That’s how you know it’s true

They quake and they shake
They break and they break 
And the walls tumble to seethe them
The crystals shatter beneath them 

They tremble for years
They fight through their tears 
And whisper in a mournful time:
“I love you”, such a cheesy line 

Love is built like stone
Until they’re left alone
And they call through the blank mirror
“I’m here”, it hasn’t been clearer 

Be her own person
In a world of greed
Be her own person
In a world not need
-ing her

That’s how she knows it’s true

Fight and crawl to thrive
Survive and survive
Though they had a number of lies,
That dear did not deserve to die

On the other hand
With tremendous land 
Lies the true rule of hearts and mind
Gone through hell, time and time and time

Lies the final tale
Lies the faulty pale 
They who conquer all destinies
Fail to conquer their tragedies 

Be her own person
In a world of greed
Be her own person
In a world not need
-ing her

Be your own person
In a world of greed
Be your own person
In a world not need
-ing you

That’s how you know it’s true

That’s how you know it’s true

_______

Jikoronpa: Laments of Isolation is a fangame for the Danganronpa series from Spike Chunsoft. It has no official relations to the series and is completely non-profit. This game may contain sensitive topics and themes, such as abuse, suicide, and other mental health issues. There will also be art depictions of gore as well. If you may feel uncomfortable with these things, please exercise caution before playing.

_______

Link to play it yourself: https://laments.itch.io/jikoronpa-laments-of-isolation-prologue-chapter-1
